    <h1>The battle tracker</h1>

{% raw %}
The battle tracker keeps a running count of how long each side has held City Hall during an Ultimate or Battle for Gotham match, so officers can see at a glance whether the league is ahead and by how much. Pressing its buttons needs **Operate the battle tracker** (officers by default). The battle tracker is part of **Premium**.

## Getting a panel

- **Automatically**: set **Battle Tracker** (and **Battle Call-outs** for the capture lines) in `/guild-settings show` → **DC Dark Legion** → **✏️ Edit channels**. The panel posts there when a Gotham event starts, and the match clock starts by itself when staging ends (10 minutes later).
- **By hand**: `/battle-tracker panel`, with the event type and, if you like, the opponent and your server. Mark it **test** for a practice run.

Only one match runs at a time: press **⏹ MATCH END** when you are done, or the next match's panel will not post. `/battle-tracker opponent` sets the opponent's name during a match.

## During the match

- **🟢 WE TOOK CH** when your league takes City Hall, **🔴 THEY TOOK CH** when the enemy does. Only the button that makes sense is lit: the side that does not hold it.
- **⏱ MISSED** marks a hold you did not see clearly, so it is left out of the averages.
- **↶ UNDO** takes back the last press, whoever made it.
- **▶ MATCH START** starts the clock, if it did not start itself.

The panel shows who holds City Hall and for how long, both totals, how far ahead or behind you are, and what each side still needs. Two presses of the same button within a few seconds count once.

**Call-outs**: each capture is posted as one short line, for whoever relays it into in-game chat, in the call-outs channel (or the tracker channel).

**🔮 The forecast**: once either side has 20:00 of hold time, the panel plays the rest of the match forward from this match's own holds: **at this pace** (each side's average hold) and **cautiously** (their longest hold every time against our shortest). When even the cautious one has us reaching 40:00 first or ahead when the clock runs out, the tracker posts **ON FORM, THEY WON'T CATCH US** in the call-out channel, and **NO LONGER SAFE ON FORM** if that changes. If even our best against their worst would lose, the panel says so, and nothing is posted. 📊 SUMMARY records from when, in match time, each forecast had us winning. The panel is redrawn every minute while the match runs.

**🏁 They can't win**: the moment our lead is bigger than the time left in the match (in a Battle for Gotham, than what their clock can still gain at its Nexus speed), the tracker posts it in the same channel by itself, once: even holding City Hall to the end, they cannot catch us. If an UNDO or a correction makes it untrue, it is posted again when it is true again.

## The Nexus (Battle for Gotham)

In a Battle for Gotham each league has a Nexus, which opens 20 minutes into the match. As it is damaged, its league's City Hall time builds more slowly: **75%** below 12,000 HP, **50%** below 6,000, and **stopped** once it is destroyed, until it is healed back to 10,000 (75% again). The game shows the speed when you hold City Hall or click the Nexus.

From 20:00 the panel has two rows under **🏰 Nexus speed**: **🟢** for your Nexus and **🔴** for the rival league's (the one with a real chance of winning), each **100% / 75% / 50% / 0%**. Press the speed the game shows whenever it changes, healing included: the tracker cannot see healing on its own. The speed already recorded is greyed out, and **↶ UNDO** takes a press back.

Each side's City Hall time is then counted at its own speed, from the moment it was pressed: the totals, the cycles, the 40:00 finish (a slowed clock gets there later), the forecast and **They can't win** all use it. The panel shows each side's speed, the cycle detail lists every change, and **THEIR NEXUS IS DOWN** / **OUR NEXUS IS DOWN** (and when one comes back) is posted in the call-outs channel. Ultimate matches have no Nexus.

## The 40:00 finish

The side that holds City Hall for 40:00 in total wins. The tracker stops the clock at that moment and shows the result. Press **⏹ MATCH END** to close the match.

## Correcting the times

If you were knocked out of the game and missed captures, press **✏️ CORRECT** and type both totals exactly as the game screen shows them, and who holds City Hall now. A blank total leaves that side alone. **↶ UNDO** takes a correction back too. A correction counts in the cycle it was entered in, marked ✏️ in the cycle detail, so the cycles add up to the corrected total.

## The summary

**📊 SUMMARY** shows, privately: both totals, the number of complete cycles (one capture each way; when the match ends, the last cycle counts too, even if one side held City Hall to the end), the average gain per cycle, each side's average hold, and the best and worst cycle. **📋 CYCLE DETAIL** lists every cycle: each side's time in it and its net, then the running totals after it (**US TOT**, **THEM TOT**) and the **GAP** between them, so you can see how the match stood at the end of every cycle. When the match ends, the cycle detail is posted in the call-outs channel.
